title: McGraw Hill Expands Literacy Portfolio with ROAR, the Only Research-Backed Dyslexia Screener for K–12
summary: Exclusive integration will bring assessment developed at the Stanford Graduate School of Education, Reading and Dyslexia Research Program to K–12 classrooms around the world Key takeaways: Exclusive integration adds ROAR, the only literacy screener designed to assess foundational reading skills across the full K–12 continuum, to McGraw Hill's literacy portfolio. ROAR, developed at the Stanford University Graduate School of Education, Reading and Dyslexia Research Program, extends McGraw Hill's ability to support educators in connecting assessment, curriculum and intervention. Expanding state requirements and focus on literacy screening are underscoring demand for solutions that identify student needs and support targeted, individualized instruction. The ROAR Foundational Reading Skills Suite is already approved for use in multiple states, including California. McGraw Hill, Inc.
